changes.zh-cn: MIUI 12.5 触碰想象，感受真实
changes.en-us: MIUI 12.5. Yours alone.

changes.zh-cn: 系统优化，更轻、更快、更省电
安卓首创手势Turbo，极速响应，流畅于心
算力升级，20倍渲染力，渲出大精彩
机型分级，不同手机，都更流畅
新增 全新MIUI光锥动效架构，全场景动画体验大幅提升
changes.en-us: New: A new animation framework renders movement more realistically.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 顶尖美学和动效设计，通感可视，感受真实
changes.en-us: New: New UI design is focused on visualization and making your interaction with the device more lifelike.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 提炼现实反馈，建立丰富触感库，带来自然触感体验
changes.en-us: New: Haptic feedback brings a new dimension to familiar actions.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 无障碍触感设计，让视障用户可快速感知信息和操作
changes.en-us: New: All accessibility features become more informative and intuitive with haptic feedback.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 通知音自然博物馆，听见万物，身临其境
changes.en-us: New: Nature mix is a new exciting way of creating your own notification sound system.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 百种环球生物之声，生灵之美，声声不息
changes.en-us: New: Hundreds of system sounds that represent animals from all around the world.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 专为双扬声器设计的系统音效
changes.en-us: New: Stereo system sounds.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 雪山超级壁纸
changes.en-us: New: Mount Siguniang super wallpaper.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 剪切板隐私保护，曝光应用读取剪切板行为，智能判断合理读取
changes.en-us: New: Now you can see what apps access your clipboard and control access.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 模糊定位，基于差分隐私技术保护你的位置信息
changes.en-us: New: Using approximate location adds up points to privacy protection.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 首家全面启用沙盒机制的安卓系统，支持单独设置敏感信息读写权限
changes.en-us: New: You can now manage sensitive permissions and related app behavior independently.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 曝光网页行为记录，拦截敏感、恶意行为
changes.en-us: New: The behavior of web pages is also tracked now, which helps you to block unwanted and malicious actions.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 上网防追踪，你的行为只有你知道
changes.en-us: New: Now it's up to you who and when can track your online behavior.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 应用商店每个APP都自带隐私说明
changes.en-us: New: All apps now come with a security statement from GetApps.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 隐私风险检测
changes.en-us: New: Privacy risk scanner.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 相册图片防误删
changes.en-us: New: Control which apps access and delete items from your Gallery.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 敏感权限危害和隐患教育
changes.en-us: New: A comprehensive overview of all sensitive permissions.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 危险权限启用的增强提示和拦截
changes.en-us: New: You'll be notified whenever high-risk permissions are used and will be able to block the corresponding actions.

changes.zh-cn: 优化 隐私保护页面全面升级
changes.en-us: Optimization: An all-new privacy protection page.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 思维笔记功能，手机上的结构化书写利器，一键生成脑图
changes.en-us: New: Compose mind maps with complex structures.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 涂鸦功能，精心调校四种画笔，细腻还原真实笔触
changes.en-us: New: New tools for doodling and sketching.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 涂鸦快速绘图功能，包括规则图形长按自动修正以及直线端点自动连接
changes.en-us: New: Press and hold a sketch to adjust the strokes automatically.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 全局待办升级为「速记」，随时查看笔记、待办、摘录
changes.en-us: New: A gesture shortcut now allows you to create notes, tasks, and excerpts anywhere.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 摘录功能，支持将图片、文字、链接一键摘录至笔记（需在商店中升级至3.1.0级以上版本）
changes.en-us: New: Excerpts save text, URLs, and images to Notes in a few simple taps.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 动态网格排版，构建文字秩序之美，让不同字号，同样优美
changes.en-us: New: Dynamic layouts make bring the typography in Notes to a new level.

changes.zh-cn: 便签全面升级为「笔记 」
changes.en-us: All-new Notes.

changes.zh-cn: 手机电脑之间，协作无间
changes.en-us: You can combine your phone and computer into a single working station.

changes.zh-cn: 支持电脑端查看手机通知，点击通知打开手机应用
changes.en-us: You can view MIUI notifications and open phone apps on your computer.

changes.zh-cn: 支持手机端应用随时切换到电脑端继续使用
changes.en-us: Apps from your phone can be handed off to your computer.

changes.zh-cn: 支持手机端、电脑端剪贴板双向同步，一端复制，一端粘贴
changes.en-us: The items copied on a phone can now be pasted on the computer and vice versa.

changes.zh-cn: 支持手机拍照、截图，实时同步到PC端使用
changes.en-us: Photos and screenshots from a mobile device can be instantly used on a computer.

changes.zh-cn: 支持手机端浏览的网页，电脑直接打开继续浏览
changes.en-us: Web pages can be seamlessly handed over from one device to another.

changes.zh-cn: 支持电脑端拖拽文件到「MIUI+」面板传输至手机
changes.en-us: You can transfer files to your mobile device using the "MIUI+" panel on your computer.

changes.zh-cn: 全新MIUI「文件管理」、「笔记」支持电脑大屏版本
changes.en-us: New "File Manager" and "Notes" for computers.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 聊天类应用通知支持长按下拉进入小窗
新增 迷你小窗与全屏应用快速互换
新增 “小窗胶囊”功能，应用处于迷你小窗时提示应用关键信息(*前往MIUI实验室中了解功能详情)
新增 手机摄像头检测心率
changes.en-us: New: You can measure your heart rate using the camera now.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 手动开始跑步、步行、骑行运动，并上线多种运动视频课程
changes.en-us: New: Start recording running, walking, and cycling workouts manually, and enjoy lots of online workout classes.

changes.zh-cn: 优化 灵弦技术2.0，自动运动识别更精准
changes.en-us: Optimization: Automatic workout recognition is much more accurate now.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 下载应用水波纹效果动画
changes.en-us: New: "Ripples" animation for downloading apps.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 卸载应用粒子爆炸效果动画
changes.en-us: New: "Burst" animation for uninstalling apps.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 全新应用文件夹设计
changes.en-us: New: New design for app folders.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 支持选择多任务横向排布方式
changes.en-us: New: A vertical layout for Recents.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 视频投屏画面自适应电视屏幕比例
changes.en-us: New: The aspect ratio is adjusted to the external monitor automatically during casting.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 小窗投屏应用音频与手机应用音频分设备播放
changes.en-us: New: The audio of the app that's being cast in a floating window is separated from other audio.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 密码管家，一键加密帐号密码数据到云端
changes.en-us: New: Password manager allows you to store passwords in the cloud.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 共享设备位置，协助设备查找
changes.en-us: New: You can share device location with other people in your family sharing group.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 关机前支持自动定位
changes.en-us: New: Location information can be recorded automatically before the device powers off.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 照片秒转PDF
changes.en-us: New: Convert images to PDF.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 支持管理多张手机卡，便捷查询、缴费
changes.en-us: New: You can manage multiple SIM cards now.

changes.zh-cn: 新增：使用滚动条更便捷地移动光标
changes.en-us: New: A more convenient way to move a cursor using the scrollbar.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 键盘底部功能键支持切换语言与切换键盘
changes.en-us: New: Function buttons support switching between languages and keyboards.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 长按键盘底部功能键唤出更多功能
changes.en-us: New: You can press and hold the function buttons to access more features.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 底部全面屏键盘优化功能区适配个性皮肤
changes.en-us: New: Custom themes for keyboards.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 第三方字体支持粗细无极调节
changes.en-us: New: Font weight adjustment options for third party fonts.

changes.zh-cn: 优化 聚合系统壁纸、动画、声音等个性化功能
changes.en-us: Optimization: Personalization features for system wallpapers, animations, and sounds.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 简洁版下支持自定义壁纸
changes.en-us: New: Wallpaper customization in the lite mode.

changes.zh-cn: 优化 无痕模式视觉设计
changes.en-us: Optimization: Redesigned Incognito mode.

changes.zh-cn: 优化 浏览器内核，加载速度更快
changes.en-us: Optimization: Pages load much faster now.

changes.zh-cn: 新增 常用场景及常用设备一步即达
优化 全新设备控制中心视觉设计
优化 本机搜索结果智能排序，更快更准确
优化 全新交互和视觉设计
